import json, random, subprocess, sys
PROG="/app/submission/scheduler.py"
rng=random.Random(7)
viol=0; total=0
for it in range(120):
    Q=rng.randint(1,8); L=rng.randint(1,6)
    U=rng.choice([1,2,5,16,64,1000])
    R=rng.randint(1,min(6,U))
    cuts=sorted(rng.sample(range(1,U),R-1)) if R>1 else []
    borders=[0]+cuts+[U]
    n=rng.randint(0,200)
    packets=[{"id":"y%d"%i,"lane":rng.randrange(L),"rank":rng.randrange(U)} for i in range(n)]
    obj={"mode":"burst","banks":Q,"lanes":L,"limit":U,"borders":borders,
         "start_bank":rng.randrange(Q),"packets":packets}
    proc=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',PROG],input=json.dumps(obj).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    out=json.loads(proc.stdout)
    for r,rep in enumerate(out["ranges"]):
        total+=1
        if rep["observed"]>rep["bound"]:
            viol+=1
            print("VIOLATION", r, rep, "Q",Q,"L",L,"borders",borders)
            if viol>5: break
    # also check counts consistency with assignment
    cnt=[[0]*Q for _ in range(len(borders)-1)]
    for a in out["assignment"]:
        cnt[a["range"]][a["bank"]]+=1
    for r,rep in enumerate(out["ranges"]):
        assert rep["counts"]==cnt[r], (rep,cnt[r])
print("checked",total,"violations",viol)
EOF
